Subject: Demo request — can VP join?

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the quick intro earlier. We'd like a technical walkthrough next week focused on integration (API, auth, latency profiles). Our CTO, Priya Rao, has indicated she'd like to attend to evaluate fit. Would you be able to schedule a 45-60 minute demo next Wednesday or Thursday with her on the call?

Ideal windows are: Wed Feb 10 between 10–12 PT or Thu Feb 11 between 13–16 PT. If those don't work, send alternatives.

Also please include a short agenda so our CTO knows which sections to prioritize.

Thanks,
Olivia

Stellar Fabrication

Quick heads-up: Priya (the Stellar CTO) mentioned she has a travel conflict on Feb 10 that just moved onto her calendar — she won't be available that day.

I can run the demo, but to make the session most effective for Priya we'd prefer she can be present for the architecture + auth section. Two slots that work for both me and our VP-level sponsor (Samir Patel) are:

- Tue Feb 16, 11:00–12:00 PT
- Wed Feb 17, 08:30–09:30 PT

If neither is feasible for the Stellar team, we can still run the session on Feb 10 and record the architecture segment for Priya to review, but there will be less opportunity for live Q&A.

Proposed 30-min agenda (we can expand to 60 if you want):
- 5 min intros & objectives
- 20 min technical walkthrough (API auth, rate limits, latency examples)
- 5 min next steps & pilot ask

I've attached a 1-pager agenda and a short bio for Samir so Priya knows who she'll be speaking with.
